// diagnostic L0512

Jet.SubjectShorthandNesting

Nested subject shorthand needs an explicit binding

What

Nested subject shorthand needs an explicit binding

Why

Implicit subjects become hard to track when shorthand scopes nest

Fix

Rewrite the inner shorthand with a named binding such as `fn(item) { item.member }`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.SubjectShorthandNesting: Tests/UILint/allow_function_rung.warn.

Warning: Jet.SubjectShorthandNesting: Subject shorthand `.len(…)` is nested inside another subject shorthand
  --> Tests/UILint/allow_function_rung.jet:8:21
    |
  8 |     words.map(.map(.len()))
    |                     ^^^
 Why: Implicit subjects become hard to track when shorthand scopes nest
 Fix: Rewrite it with a named binding: `fn(item) { item.len(…) }`
